_source: Google Cloud deck — 'Transition today to 3.7 Flash' / 'What are the recommended migration paths?'
_note: Google's VENDOR migration recommendation: regardless of the model an agent runs today, consolidate onto a small set of current Gemini GA targets. Cross-provider by design (Anthropic Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, OpenAI GPT/Mini/Nano, and older Gemini all map onto a Gemini target). This is the PREFERRED recommendation (migration_target); the same-provider cost-downgrade (next_cheaper) is the FALLBACK when no path matches. `from[].re` is a REGEX matched against the canonicalized model id, so 'families' like 'any Opus' / 'any *-mini' resolve without listing every id. First matching path wins. NOTE: Google frames this as a QUALITY gain at maintained price/code, NOT a cost cut — the report shows the honest cost delta.

paths.value: immediate quality gain while maintaining existing price and code
